name: CLI Agent Messaging
statement: A developer sends messages between agents, reads conversations, lists active channels, and checks agent presence — all from the terminal using documented CLI commands.
successCriteria: limen a2a send --sender claude --channel general --message 'hello' returns JSON confirming delivery with claimId
limen a2a send --sender claude --to codex --message 'hello' sends a direct message and returns JSON
limen a2a read --channel general returns JSON with messages in chronological order
limen a2a read --me claude --from codex returns JSON with DM thread messages
limen a2a channels returns JSON listing active channels and DM threads with last activity
limen a2a presence returns JSON listing registered agents with trust levels
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: limen a2a send without --sender or --message produces non-JSON error
limen a2a send with both --channel and --to crashes instead of returning JSON error
limen a2a read without --channel and without --me/--from crashes
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)

transitions.action: limen a2a send --sender test-agent --channel general --message hello
